classes.name: SNRIs
classes.description: Venlafaxine IR/ER (tablet and capsule), desvenlafaxine (Pristiq), duloxetine (Cymbalta, Drizalma), levomilnacipran (Fetzima).
classes.plainDescription: A daily antidepressant that also helps some nerve pain.

classes.name: Bupropion
classes.description: Bupropion IR, SR, XL (Wellbutrin, Wellbutrin XL, Forfivo XL, Aplenzin); exclude Zyban labeling for smoking cessation and naltrexone/bupropion (Contrave).
classes.plainDescription: A daily antidepressant that does not usually cause weight gain or sexual side effects.

classes.name: Other antidepressants
classes.description: Mirtazapine (Remeron, ODT), trazodone, vilazodone (Viibryd), vortioxetine (Trintellix), dextromethorphan/bupropion (Auvelity), nefazodone.
classes.plainDescription: Other daily antidepressants, including ones often used at night for sleep.
